newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo closes weaker vs mark, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Escudo closes weaker vs mark, seen rising.

text.p: The escudo closed weaker against the mark, but dealers said it was set to rise in the coming sesions as investors bought escudos to pay for shares in newly privatised utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal. "With the heavy volume now seen on the bourse, especially in EDP, and many foreign investors active, the escudo is poised to rise," a dealer said. The escudo ended at 100.88/91 per mark, compared with 100.72/75 at the opening.
